Hai!  
Maaf, saya tidak punya akses langsung ke inventaris toko atau gudang.  
Apakah kamu sedang mencari celana dalam ukuran L di toko tertentu (misalnya online marketplace, brand spesifik, atau toko fisik)? Kalau begitu, beri tahu nama toko atau platformnya, dan saya bisa bantu cek ketersediaan atau memberi saran tempat lain yang biasanya stoknya lengkap.  

Terima kasih!

Means: "Bro, are there 1 dozen underwear size L ready?" They want to know if there's a dozen of size L underwear ready. They might be asking to purchase or check availability. We need to respond appropriately. There's no mention of authentication. The user is not asking for login. So we don't need to call the function. Just respond in Indonesian. Provide a helpful answer: maybe ask for more details, location, store, etc. Or say we don't have inventory info. We can ask for more context.
